mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales growth signal a broad-based consumer demand slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production growth above 1.5% year-over-year, supply chain improvements and manufacturing expansion boost corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% YoY, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI growth exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls over the past month indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales growth (RSAFS) falls below 0.5% year-over-year, it indicates slowing consumer demand that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS YoY is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in industrial production and quarterly GDP signals a robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 show growth, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.02.
